label: GOD_4 exists from a MAXIME_1 cause of all being, with more in being (inference)
rule: Existential elimination; uniqueness by excluded middle and the instance at esse of more such; the fuller naming premise
meaning: Sibling of GOD-EXISTS-FROM-MAXIME-ENS-CAUSING-ALL with the instance at esse of 'more such' (formal reading, same MoreIn) in place of the unrestricted premise, which that proof uses only at esse. Some MAXIME_1 being m causes the being of every other being. Another maximum m' has being, so m causes its being and is more in being than it, contradicting the maximality of m'; excluded middle decides identity, so m is the only maximum. m causes every perfection of every other being (the cause of being causes every perfection; whatever is in act has being) and is remote from all (it is the first being, and no component is), so the fuller naming premise applies and GOD_4 exists. Each premise except excluded middle is needed in a checked interpretation (omission models). The esse instance is derived without 'nothing gives what it does not have', so this route survives its removal under strict expansion. Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
